session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend From The Open, Then Trading Range'. Bull trend from the open rallies through a parabolic wedge to 5650, the double top breakout fails; higher low double bottoms at 5628 and 5631 hold the midday, then the market concludes in a trading range closing at 5646.
